title: Integer division
summary: Why 5 / 2 is 2, and how to get 2.5.

steps.title: Whole numbers only
steps.say: When both sides of `/` are `int`s, Java does **integer division** and throws away the remainder.

board.code:
int a = 5 / 2;        // 2, not 2.5
double b = 5 / 2;     // still 2.0!
double c = 5 / 2.0;   // 2.5
double d = (double) 5 / 2;  // 2.5

marks.label: one double makes it decimal division
a cast turns the int into a double first

steps.title: Where it bites
steps.say: Averages are the classic trap: a total of whole numbers divided by a count. Make one side a `double` before dividing.
